acceptance_tests: Approved proposal and all four prototype authority hashes match exactly.
All allocated IDs and revisions are conflict-free against record set 000033 and the current catalog/provider closure.
The root graph elaborates to nine inspectable internal nodes; the fused factory is selected only by exact graph/contract/hash match and never replaces graph identity.
All 24 controller selectors map exactly once to public instrument facets and exhaustive comparison against the prototype map passes.
Initialization, Reset, Panic, Freeze, mode change, recall, reconnect deferral, and non-finite recovery match the state matrix.
Target-independent validation precedes target/backend/provider selection and every missing, stale, ambiguous, disabled, or unsupported closure fails closed.
The seven-condition experiment is repeatable across fresh processes and block partitions and passes all ledger, event-cap, pitch, peak, DC, finite, and comparator tolerances.
Task 031/032 seven-factory behavior and historical package bytes remain exact.
Current, affected native, sanitizer, and copied-root checks pass once after implementation freeze.
No device, real-time, listening, packaging, distribution, or release evidence is promoted.

may: Implement only the exact allocations, schemas, graph split, fusion match, operations, numeric route, fixed capacities, state model, and corrections frozen by this bundle.
Reject or narrow the fused Q27 realization if the comparator or safety experiment fails while preserving the transparent semantic graph.
Record measured float/Q27 deviations without claiming equivalence.
must_not: Change the lane from new-design or import external DSP source.
Use provider, target, controller, collection, runtime factory, source path, or display name as graph identity.
Hide internal graph nodes behind the fused implementation or allow a non-exact fusion match.
Add a float provider, juce_dsp, arbitrary native extension ABI, application UI, endpoint access, hardware action, commit, push, or publication without separate authority.
Waive a tolerance, rebaseline historical evidence, or infer a higher evidence level from a lower one.
